item.title: 9 Kings
item.description:
Title: 9 Kings
Genre: RPG , Strategy
Developer: Sad Socket
Publisher: Hooded Horse , Sidekick Publishing
Release Date: Nov 12, 2026
Early Access Release Date: May 23, 2025




About This Game

Build your city into the most powerful of all kingdoms through endless combinations of buildings, units, spells, and positioning. Take advantage of chaotic combos and powerful perks to break the game and become overpowered. Grow your kingdom in strategic ways, prepare for dozens of unique events, and show the world your kingdom can outlast all others in both single and async multiplayer.

From humble village to massive citadel, your capital recruits your units and grows their power. Expand your kingdom strategically over time and build it to survive decades of war and strife.

From sturdy knights and warlocks, to glass cannon wizards and bombers, to hordes of fiendish imps and sentient mushrooms, there are dozens of units to lead and fight. Stockpile gold to hire thousands of mercenaries to your cause, use dark magic to raise the dead, and harness nature itself to bring down your enemies!

Each of the kings has a different starting deck of buildings, troops, and spells, but you can loot the rival kings who attack your lands to access cards from their unique decks. Make peace with those whose units don’t fit your playstyle, and declare war against kings with the powers and units you covet, deploying the tools acquired from your enemy to unlock countless combinations of stacking buffs and modifiers to build an invincible army.

Async multiplayer mode pits you against eight rival kings to see whose kingdom survives the longest. Climb the ranks and prove yourself to truly be the king of kings, complete with cosmetic customization using rewards you’ve unlocked through daily challenges and medals earned along the way.

Quest Mode introduces unique mechanics-bending challenges as you travel the known world and face off against its kings to collect their crowns for yourself.

Joker Mode lets you design your own deck mixing cards from all nine kings while setting your own rules – starting gold, number of lives, decrees, and more. Perfect your favorite strategy or turn your reign into a wild experiment!

Endless Mode has you choose a king and face endless attacks from enemy kings and their most powerful warriors – how long can you survive the onslaught?

Combine your cards in endless ways – try out insane builds and watch massive armies fight for your crown, survive as long as you can against increasingly powerful enemies, or break the game and watch all challengers crumble before you.

item.title: Car Flipper
item.description:
Title: Car Flipper
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: Dynyx Interactive Inc
Publisher: Dynyx Interactive Inc
Release Date: Nov 12, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Nov 12, 2026




About This Game

Buy low. Sell high. Don't get burned.

That door looks just as shiny as the rest of the car. Run the paint tester over it and the reading jumps, because somebody painted over something and the seller forgot to mention it. Every car in Car Flipper has a story, and the seller is only telling you part of it.

The good news is that plenty of what puts buyers off is cheap to fix. Foggy headlights make a car look years older. Work the compound in, spray them clear, and the same car suddenly looks like somebody took care of it. Buy what looks rough, fix what buyers notice, and sell it for more.

Car Flipper is a first person game about buying used cars off strangers and selling them for more than you paid. There's no dealership and no staff, just you, a phone full of listings and not a lot of cash in a small town called Pine Hollow. You can do all of it on your own, or bring up to three friends along and split the work.

Reading the car

The listings tell you more than they mean to. Some sellers own up to everything. Some forget a thing or two. Some round the miles down and somehow never get around to sending a picture of the engine. Ask for more photos, run the history report, then go and see it for yourself.

Not every car is on the apps, either. Some are just parked on the side of the road with a For Sale sign in the window. Walk up and text the number on the sign, and the seller writes back with the price and the miles and comes out to meet you.

Once you're there, pop the hood and check the oil. Milky oil usually means a head gasket, and if it sparkles there's metal in it.

Plug the scanner in under the dash and the codes come up on your phone. Sometimes you'll find out somebody cleared them right before you showed up, which tells you plenty on its own.

Walk around the body with the paint tester, mark every dent and scratch you find, and bring all of it up when you start talking price. Last of all, start it up and look for smoke, unless the seller already had it running before you got there.

Can't make it out yourself? Pay the mobile mechanic to go and have a look. He'll tell you what he found, and he'll also tell you what he didn't bother checking.

Storage auctions

Every Monday and Friday at 9 AM, Pine Hollow Self Storage sells off the units nobody's paid for. Buy a bidder ticket at the desk, take your paddle and wait for the doors to roll up. There's a car inside, and it's locked. You can't open it, start it or plug anything into it, so all you get is a look from behind the tape. How much dust is on it, what's leaked onto the floor, what's sitting in the boxes next to it.

Then the bidding starts, and the regulars won't make it easy. Win and you pay a premium on top, and no keys means a call to the locksmith. Some of these cars just sat too long. Some of them look fine and are dead inside.

Fixing it up

Once it's yours, the mechanic puts it on the lift and hands you an invoice with everything that's actually wrong with it. You only pay for the inspection on the problems you missed, so it pays to look properly.

What gets fixed after that is up to you. Do the headlights yourself, wash it at the car wash or at home with your own pressure washer, or leave it with the shop for repairs and a respray.

The shop does more than repairs, too. You can change the paint finish, add stripes or a second color, tint the windows, fit underglow or a custom plate, and change the ride height. Performance parts cover the brakes, suspension, gearbox, exhaust and induction, and you even get to pick the color of your tire smoke and exhaust flames (a few of those colors come with the Supporter Pack).

If you'd rather save the money, head out to the junkyard. Grab a wrench, pull the door or bumper or headlight you need off one of the wrecks, and pay the clerk on your way out. Parts only fit cars that share the same body, and the good stuff doesn't sit there long because other pickers come through too. Some cars just aren't worth saving, and the yard will happily take those off your hands for scrap.

Selling it on

Take your own photos, pick a price and post it on Curbside or Dougslist. Buyers message you, come by, walk around the car and haggle over whatever they spot. Rinse it properly first, because nobody wants a car that's still covered in soap. Agree on a price, shake hands, and watch them drive off in it.

Rent it out

A car doesn't have to sit in the driveway while you wait for the right buyer. Once you hit level 4 you can list it on Keyswap and rent it out by the day. You pick the price, the deposit and how many miles a day they get. Requests come in on their own, every renter comes with reviews, and you can ask a couple of questions before you say yes.

When it's time, drive the car to the spot the app marks on your map, park it in the box and walk away. The renter shows up and drives off in it, and every so often you'll see it go past in traffic. If they bring it back late, short on gas or over the miles, the fees come out of their deposit.

Drag racing

On Friday and Saturday nights the racers line up at the Strip. Walk along the curb, check out their cars and pick who you want to run against. Put some cash on it, roll up to the line and watch the lights. Go on green. Go early and you've lost before you've even moved.

From level 6 you can race for pink slips, one a night, and whoever loses walks home. Some of them have more under the hood than they're letting on.

When there's no race on, the roads around town are all yours, traffic and all.

Bring your friends

Invite up to three friends through Steam and they join your game with characters they made themselves. Everyone sees the same phone and the same money. One of you can drive while the others ride along in the passenger and back seats, and anyone can point out the rust the seller was hoping nobody would notice.

You decide how far you trust each of them. A Visitor can look around and help inspect. A Helper can message sellers, fuel up and wash cars. A Partner can agree on prices and even sign for a loan. Everybody carries their own gas can, so nobody drinks your fuel, but the money for refills still comes out of the business.

Bigger cars, bigger risks

You're never going to end up running a dealership. You get better at reading cars, and you level up. Each level opens up something new to buy, like an OBD scanner, a bigger gas can, a pressure washer for home, or another app for the phone. The local shop starts treating you like a regular too.

The cars go from tired commuter sedans all the way up to supercars, and the expensive ones cost more than you'll have saved. That's what the bank is for. Borrow what you need, pay it back every week with a fee on top, and try not to miss a payment.

Home is the workshop at the end of the driveway, because the homeowners association sealed your garage. There's room for thirteen cars and that's it, so you'll keep having to choose between a quick sale, renting it out and waiting for the right buyer.

Features

  • Online with up to four players, with passenger seats, a shared wallet and trust levels you set for each friend.

  • A first person inspection with the dipstick, a paint tester, an OBD scanner and your own eyes.

  • Hidden problems on every car, and sellers who warm engines up, clear the codes and roll the odometer back.

  • Two listing apps, history reports that only know what got reported, paid alerts, and tips from the regulars at the bar.

  • Cars for sale on the side of the road, with the seller's number on the sign in the window.

  • Storage auctions twice a week, where you bid on a car you're not allowed to touch.

  • Hands on fixing up with headlight restoration, the car wash, junkyard parts, and a mechanic with a paint booth.

  • A shop that customizes and tunes, from paint finishes, tint and underglow to brakes, gearbox and exhaust.

  • Buyers who look your car over and argue about what they find.

  • Keyswap, a rental app that puts your cars to work between sales.

  • Drag races on Friday and Saturday nights, for cash or for pink slips.

  • Sixteen cars from cheap sedans to supercars, and bank loans for when you want the ones you can't afford.

  • Tools and apps you unlock as you level up, plus an old computer in the workshop that runs the same apps (most of the time).

  • A whole town to get around in, with traffic on the roads, your workshop, the gas station, the bank, the junkyard, the storage lot, the bar, the bus, and a tow truck for when things go wrong.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

We used an AI assistant to help with writing. That covers this store page, our Early Access notes, and some in-game text we wanted to read better. We also used it in a few minor areas of the code, and to translate our in-game text from English into 30 languages.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or Windows 11 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 25 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700 or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (12 GB)
    • Storage: 25 GB available space

item.title: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
item.description:
Title: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
Genre: Simulation , Strategy , Early Access
Developer: Falling Damage Games
Publisher: Falling Damage Games
Release Date: Nov 12, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Nov 12, 2026




About This Game

Build the Legendary Ski Resort you've always dreamed of.

You start with just a ticket office and a bit of cash. Transform an empty mountain into a Legendary Resort in this management tycoon game from an industry veteran and passionate skier.

No rigid grid system. Paint trails directly onto terrain built from real LiDAR data from around the world.

You need a variety of trails for all types of skiers: green circles for beginners, black diamonds for the brave.

Build cozy ski villages with lodges, restaurants, après bars, shopping, and more!

See to the needs of thousands of guests as they arrive at your resort - everyone wants something different, so make sure to keep them happy. Some are there to chill, others are there to shred.
Watch a Jerry wipe out on an expert trail he had no business entering! And make sure you have enough Ski Patrol hired to help him out after you’re done laughing.

Not everyone came to ski! Place buildings that satisfy a variety of guests, from waffle stands to spas, warming huts to five-star hotels.

Every peak is built from real-world elevation data: the actual ridgelines, fall lines, and the weather that comes with them.

  • Snow falls, settles, melts, and drifts on a GPU-simulated snowpack, and skiers carve real grooves into the powder as they go.

  • An El Niño year turns the storms warm and wet. Snow turns to rain and wipes out your trails.

  • Drought means running snowblowers around the clock just to stay open.

  • A big dump buries your buildings before the lifts even spin.

  • A cool summer keeps your peaks soft and fluffy for the next season.

  • The East is cold and icy, with little natural snow. Run your snowmakers to keep your guests from wiping out.

  • Utah serves up light, consistent powder, the most forgiving place to build.

  • The Sierras flip between massive blizzards that bury your mountains and stubborn dry spells that melt what's there.

  • The Colorado Rockies pair dependable snowfall with brutal, high-altitude cold that tests how warm you keep your guests.

  • And the Pacific Northwest never stops dumping deep, heavy snow, keeping your groomers working overtime.

Play across every major ski region on Earth - from the five US regions to Japan, the Alps, the Andes, Canada, Australia and New Zealand, and China.

item.title: Bottled by Bears
item.description:
Title: Bottled by Bears
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: monoii studio
Publisher: monoii studio
Release Date: Nov 12, 2026




About This Game

Bottled By Bears is a cozy idle management game where you run a little honey farm with the Pawford bear family. Open bee packs to collect bees of all kinds, grow a flowery field that blooms day by day, and bottle the sweetest honey jars to sell at your stand.

At your own pace, get ready to:

  • Open different bee packs to discover new and rarer bees. Can you collect them all?

  • Manage your hives and bottling lines to keep up with honey production.

  • Attract new customers and take on bigger honey orders as your reputation grows.

  • Expand your farm, decorate it, and arrange the flower fields that keep blooming even while you're away.

Settle in with the Pawfords, manage and take care of the farm, and fill the hives with your favorite bees along the way!

Title: Handmancers
Genre: Indie , RPG , Strategy
Developer: 58BLADES
Publisher: 58BLADES , Human Qube Games
Release Date: Nov 12, 2026
Early Access Release Date: May 5, 2026




About This Game

Powerful plays tire your fingers. Heavy moves raise cramps that limit options until you recover, turning every play into a tradeoff: burst the boss down now, or conserve for a longer fight. Corruption creeps across the map, tempting you with potent rewards while it twists the dangers you face. Choose artifacts, shape your hand, and push deeper into the map where the rules stay simple, but the choices never are.

Pure Rock, Paper, Scissors Combat

Combat is built around immediate, clear choices: pick a Sign, punish the right target, and capitalize on mistakes. Bait and counter - it’s Rock, Paper, Scissors elevated into tense, combo-driven duels.

Build Your Hand

Cards change how Signs behave and interact. Collect, upgrade, and combine cards to craft a hand that solves the problems enemies throw at you. Each upgrade brings you closer to greatness.

Mind Your Moves

Big moves hurt your fingers. Every heavy play increases cramps and reduces options until you recover, forcing decisions: spend big for a win now, or pace yourself for survival.

Magic at Your Fingertips

Corruption offers massive boons at a cost, and artifacts bend the rules in unexpected ways. Be smart about what power to grab - and when it’s best to resist the temptation altogether.

Key Features:

  • Rock, Paper, Scissor Combat. Simple rules, where each Sign counters another, forming the core of every encounter and shaping all deck and strategy decisions

  • First Person Deckbuilder Roguelike. Experience the tactical depth of a deckbuilder as a duelist, not a person slamming cards on the table

  • Customize Your Hand. Each card can have up to three modifiers. Combine it right and turn your gestures into nukes

  • Play in Style. Pick your faction and solidify your play style: deliver heavy damage with Scissors, play defensively with Rock or stuck buffs with Paper

  • Reach Into Corruption. Corruption disrupts the game, bringing the fourth unbeatable element to the table. This power comes with a hefty price though

Eternity is at your fingertips. Can your hands handle it?
